description.value: Bazaar Convenience and Smoke Shop is a compact urban convenience store in downtown Vancouver's West Hastings corridor, stocking snacks, exotic drinks, tobacco products, vapes, and smoking accessories. Located near the heart of the city, it caters to pedestrians and passersby looking for a quick snack or convenience item. Touring cyclists riding through downtown Vancouver will find it a handy spot to grab drinks and snacks.
